findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/PathConnected.lean:16,36` defines `Path.segment` for any real topological module, while TauCeti Fredholm files already use `IsRCLikeNormedField` as the common real/complex abstraction (`Criteria.lean:46`, `ClosedRange.lean:55`).
findings.fix: State the theorem for `K` under `IsRCLikeNormedField K` (installing its `RCLike` structure locally as elsewhere in TauCeti), retaining real coefficients for the affine segment; this covers both real and complex Fredholm operators.
findings.issue: `fredholmIndex_eq_of_segment` specializes the operator field to `ℝ`, although `Path.segment` only needs a real module and applies to complex continuous-linear maps as well.

summary: The affine-segment corollary is unnecessarily restricted to real operators, excluding the equally natural complex Fredholm case.
